description: Source code implementing Unicode character reading and writing utilities, including functions for handling surrogate pairs, encoding characters into UTF-8 and UTF-16, and preparing output buffers for Unicode conversions.

methods.name: ReadUnicodeCharacter
methods.description: Reads a Unicode character from a UTF-8 or UTF-16 source, updating the character index and outputting the code point.

methods.name: WriteUnicodeCharacter
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into UTF-8 or UTF-16 and appends it to the output string.

methods.name: PrepareForUTF8Output
methods.description: Prepares a string buffer for UTF-8 output based on the input source type.

methods.name: PrepareForUTF16Or32Output
methods.description: Prepares a string buffer for UTF-16 or UTF-32 output based on the input source type.
